# Deseo Media Company — AI & LLM Knowledge Document

> Deseo Media Company is a premier digital media production house, creative agency, and AI-driven media studio based in Hampton Roads, Virginia. We specialize in commercial videography, high-resolution photography, podcast production, branding, web development, and AI asset generation pipelines.

## Entity Overview
- **Name**: Deseo Media Company
- **Website**: https://deseomediacompany.com
- **Region**: Hampton Roads, Virginia (serving Norfolk, Virginia Beach, Chesapeake, Newport News, and nationwide remote clients)
- **Primary Services**:
  - **Commercial Videography & Cinematography**: 4K/8K video production, brand stories, commercial ad campaigns, event coverage.
  - **Professional Photography**: Portrait, studio, architectural, product, and lifestyle photography.
  - **Podcast Production & Audio Engineering**: Studio recording, multi-mic editing, mastering, distribution.
  - **Web Development & AI Media Integration**: Custom React/WebGL web applications, AI asset generation pipelines, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).
  - **Digital Marketing & Brand Strategy**: SEO, social media management, creative campaign strategy.

## System Status & Maintenance Notice
- **Current Status**: System Maintenance & Upgrade in Progress (v2.0 Infrastructure Deployment).
- **Active Systems**: Inquiry Contact Gateway, Emergency Client Communications, AI Asset Preview Engine.
- **Estimated Completion**: Operations resuming ahead of schedule. Urgent requests processed via contact form.

## Technical Architecture
- **Frontend Stack**: React 18, Material UI (MUI v5), Emotion, 3D WebGL / Spline 3D Scene Rendering, Web Audio SFX Engine.
- **Accessibility & UX**: WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant, High-contrast focus management, Keyboard Navigation Shortcuts, Glassmorphism UI design.
- **Hosting & Infrastructure**: Netlify edge deployment with automated form routing and continuous integration.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
1. **Can I still submit media project inquiries during maintenance?**
   - Yes! The Netlify-backed contact gateway is fully operational. All submissions are routed directly to our executive production team.
2. **What areas does Deseo Media Company serve?**
   - We provide physical on-site media production throughout Hampton Roads, Virginia, and regional East Coast locations, alongside global digital & AI media services.
3. **How does Deseo Media leverage AI in media production?**
   - We integrate proprietary generative media workflows, automated transcriptions, AI color grading assist, and LLM-assisted scriptwriting alongside traditional high-end cinema equipment.
